correctness.rationale: For a regular n-gon with unit incircle and k rotated sets, normal angular gaps g sum 2π/n. Tangency triangles yield area nΣtan(g_i/2), polar normal convex hull yields area n/2 Σsin(g_i), including zero gaps by continuity. The pairwise derivative identity reduces strict Schur concavity to DA−B>0, D=(1+cos g_i)(1+cos g_j). With s=g_i+g_j≤π/2, D≥2 gives positive terms; for s>π/2, s≤2π/3, D≥1, remaining sine sum≤π/6 and sin s≥√3/2, so strict positivity. Strict balancing transfers imply global majorization and only equal-gap/vertex equality cases. The Taylor second derivative on Σeps=0 has coefficient −n²k cos(gbar)tan²(gbar/2)/4, as stated. No numerical tests are used as all-parameter proof.
